# guide blob

Links a slice to the content-addressed digest of its Tier-2 narrative guide as embedded in a GTS package (#325): the guide rides the same file as the ontology, sub-profiled per slice, and a consumer resolves guide ↔ slice from the graph itself. The value is the blob digest string; the docs-in-sync invariant (every guide anchor resolves to a live term) is enforced by the package build, so the linkage is trustworthy from the hash chain alone (Principle 7).
